rule.title: ABLE-account earnings used for qualified disability expenses, or rolled over in 60 days, are not income

citation.wording: Generally, amounts distributed that are used to pay for qualified disability expenses, or rolled over to another ABLE account within 60 days, are not included in income.

rule.open_point: A program-to-program transfer is not in box 1 at all (the face says so), so no rule acts on it. A partly qualified distribution's taxable part is a computation; box 2 then counts as printed.
